3. What is a brim clip? Tap to see how it works

A brim clip slides onto the brim of a cap. No tools needed. Your engraving sits on the flat top.

4. Pick a design

A dark drawing on a light background works best. JPG, PNG or SVG, up to 4 MB. We clean it up and send a proof for your approval.

Initials or a short name. Keep it short, the clip is small. With the frame (design 27), the text goes inside the frame.

5. Quantity, delivery and price

Price is per clip, before tax. Shipping is a flat $5.00 per order. For more than one clip, or different designs on each, we'll confirm the total with your proof. A needed-by date is a request, not a guarantee.
